items.title: AI Film 'Gods Don't Give Gifts' Deemed Ineligible by Academy for Best Animated Feature Oscar

items.title: AI filmmaking: how director Perry Bhandal works solo using gen AI tools
items.excerpt: Indie filmmaker Perry Bhandal, who released the AI-generated feature 'Okay, It's Time To Go', gives a detailed first-hand account of what solo gen-AI feature production actually involves versus his 18-day conventional shoots.

items.title: Maxon Plus Intros New AI-Assisted Tools and 3D Review Services
items.excerpt: Maxon launched Maxon Plus, a suite of connected services including a Model Generator that turns text or a reference image into a 3D base model and a Texture Generator, integrated with Cinema 4D and ZBrush, plus browser-based 3D review.

items.title: Boris FX releases Silhouette 2027

items.title: How We Built CorridorKey 2.0 | Live Demo & Q&A
